visual_appeal: The hero's right column is the weakest area. '1.7' is large, but 'levels banked' and 'Then Le Beouf, full for 8h' sit at different right insets. Right-align all three to one x, 12 px inside the hero edge.
Put a 6 px gap between 'levels banked' and 'Then...', and dim the 'Then' line to #B8A888 so the eye reads it last.
The hero bar reads as a long flat strip. Add a 1 px inner highlight (#FFFFFF at 12% alpha) along its top edge, and give it the same segment ticks the card bar has, so the two bars feel related.
state_colours: Two of the RESTING row's cues look like the NOT RESTING rows. The orange rail #E07A2A and the red rail are close at 3 px width. Widen all rails to 4 px.
Shift resting toward amber-orange (#E8902E) and keep not-resting at #D23A2A, so they are clearly different hues.
The red row tint on rows 6-7 is good. Give the resting row a matching faint tint (#E8902E at 6% alpha) so all four states use the same system.

Under ElvUI the filled chips (saturated green, yellow and red fills) are louder than anything in his windows. Drop the chip fill alpha to about 35%, keep the 1 px coloured border, and keep the label at full colour.
character_identity: The row portraits are 34 px and the class badge overlaps them at about 12 px. The badge reads as noise: raise it to 14 px with a 1 px dark ring (#120C08) so it separates from the face.
On the card, the 'z z' sleep glyph floats detached above the ring. Anchor it to the ring's top-right at a 4 px offset, and fade it at 70%.
Ring colour already encodes state. Add a 2 px outer dark halo (#000000 at 60%) to the card ring so it reads against both the inn art and the black ElvUI stage.
default_theme: The #1 disc in the hero's top-left corner now looks orphaned from the portrait. Move it to sit on the ring at 10 o'clock, 4 px outside the ring stroke, or fold it into the '#1 · PLAY NEXT' kicker.
The Compact button's bronze face (#7A5A32-ish) is muddy at 20 px tall. Lift the face to #8C6A3A, add a 1 px top highlight (#C8A060 at 40%), and keep the label in cream #F0E0B8.
The footer 'Synced 2d ago from Acct #3' is 11-12 px grey on brown. Use 12 px #A89878, and align its baseline with the checkbox label.
elvui_wc3_fit: The title still reads near-white cream in both ElvUI renders (main and card), not the #F0D890 gold of his Options and Character titles. Verify that the colour is applied after the skin's SetTextColor; it looks overridden.

The ElvUI card stage is pure black with a lighter wood strip above it from the frame header. Fill the stage with his panel colour (#1A120C) plus a very subtle bottom vignette, so it is not a black hole next to his dark-brown windows.
The ElvUI card's bar butts directly against the stage bottom (about 4 px). Give it 10 px, as in the default card.

The hero name in Mage cyan at 26 px is the brightest element under ElvUI. Keep the class colour, but render it at about 90% brightness, matching how his Character window keeps the level/class line restrained.
Chip fills: see state_colours. Translucent fills with crisp borders match his Options window's flat dark cells far better.
alerts_ux: The banner title uses a pinkish #F0B0A0. Use the cream-gold #F0D890 for the headline and keep the red only on the left rail and icon, so it matches his windows and is less shrill.
The 'Up next: Le Nette · Full' button is 20 px tall with 12 px text. Make it 22 px, and colour 'Full' in the state green #5AC85A so the reason to switch is visible at a glance.
The gear and close icons sit at different sizes (14 vs 18 px). Make both 16 px, 6 px apart, vertically centred on the title line.
Toast (scene 06): 'Jacques Hammer: rested XP used up' at 11-12 px muted is the reason for the toast. Raise it to 12 px #D8C8A8.
readability: The moons are too dim when empty (about #3A3020 on #1C140E) and only about 10 px. Raise them to 12 px, set empty moons to #5A4A34, and set filled moons to #E8D8A8.
The legend line in the header band ('2 full · 2 nearly full...') is about 11 px. Make it 12 px, and give its icons 4 px gaps from the text.
Row sub-lines ('Lv 19 · Thunder Bluff · 3d ago') are grey #A0A0A0 on dark. Use #B8AC94, warm to match the theme, at 12 px.
layout_polish: In default, the Now Playing pill 'OUTSIDE A REST AREA' is right-aligned but taller than the chips below (about 18 vs 20 px). Make all pills and chips 20 px tall with 8 px horizontal padding.
The STATE header sits slightly left of the chip centre in default (about 4 px). Recentre it.
The max-level row's 'Max level. I keep the bench warm.' starts at the bar column. Italicise it or tint it #9A8A70 so it does not read as data.
The ElvUI main window has about 22 px of left gutter versus about 20 px on the right. Equalise the gutters.
delight: The speech lines are good. Give the hero tag ('Water's conjured.') the same two-line treatment as the card, with a dim second line such as 'Brill inn can spare me now.', since it is the first thing seen.
On the first-run screen, swap the faction-crest portrait for the 'Log each alt in once' illustration once he logs a second character, so the empty state visibly 'fills in'.
Add a 150 ms fade/slide on the #1 hero when the sort order changes, so the new top character is noticed.

overall_notes: This is a strong, coherent round. Play-next hierarchy is excellent: hero, the instruction band with one red action, now playing, then a clean ranked roster with a consistent rail, bar and chip state system. The default theme is warm and unified now that the buttons share a family. The remaining gaps are small but visible. In ElvUI mode the titles still render near-white rather than his gold, the saturated chip fills are louder than his subtle skin, and the ElvUI card stage is a black void with the bar crammed under it. Readability nits remain: the moons are too dim and the legend text is too small. The alerts are concise and useful, with a slightly shrill pink headline. This is not yet a 9 overall for a demanding user, but it is close.
